title: ETA Range
summary: Quotes delivery as a realistic date range, naming a likely day only when one stands out, so customers aren't promised an impossible day.
description: Quotes the range covering 90% of deliveries, with a most likely day only when one stands out ("Thu 15 – Sat 17 Oct, most likely Fri 16"), counts business days, holidays and the cutoff in the shipper's zone, previews the post-cutoff range and explains when it widened.
catches: False precision, by quoting a range instead of one date
Holidays and no-delivery days inside the range
The order cutoff, with the range you get after it
A range that widened since last shown, with the reason
limits: Accuracy depends on the delivery distribution and calendar you pass
The 90% range is a statistical estimate, not a carrier guarantee
a11y: The distribution chart is aria-hidden, with a text version of each day's share
aria-busy while the clock hasn't loaded
stops: Delivery promised on an impossible day
